```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = 'asis')
```

```{r packages}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
})
```

```{r, error=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Expect an object called `results` in the environment or read it here.
# Example:
# results <- read.csv("results.csv", check.names = FALSE)

source("main.R")
stopifnot(exists("results"))

# Round as requested
results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    rho = round(rho, 1),
    across(
      c(`True value`, `Estimate (unweighted)`, `SD (unweighted)`,
        `Estimate (weighted)`, `SD (weighted)`),
      ~ round(.x, 2)
    )
  )
```

```{r helper}
make_table <- function(df_outcome, outcome_name) {
  df <- df_outcome %>%
    select(-outcome)  # drop leftmost outcome column
  
  tab <- df %>%
    kable(
      format = if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "latex" else "html",
      booktabs = knitr::is_latex_output(),
      longtable = knitr::is_latex_output(),
      caption = paste("Simulation results for", outcome_name),
      align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(
      latex_options = if (knitr::is_latex_output()) c("hold_position", "repeat_header") else NULL,
      font_size = 9
    )
  
  # IMPORTANT: explicitly print so it appears in the document
  print(tab)
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

## Thrombocytopenia
```{r}
make_table(filter(results, outcome == "Thrombocytopenia"), "Thrombocytopenia")
```

## ITP
```{r}
make_table(filter(results, outcome == "ITP"), "ITP")
```

## Venous
```{r}
make_table(filter(results, outcome == "Venous"), "Venous")
```

## Arterial
```{r}
make_table(filter(results, outcome == "Arterial"), "Arterial")
```

## Hemorrhagic
```{r}
make_table(filter(results, outcome == "Hemorrhagic"), "Hemorrhagic")
```
